01 Structured memory infrastructure

イツキITSUKI / MEMORY THAT CARRIES FORWARD

Not more context.
Better memory.

Itsuki turns conversations, documents, and events into structured memory — source-linked, versioned, and reversible — that applications, assistants, agents, and workflows carry across sessions and tools.

Start building → Read the docs
02 Developer surface

Connect once.
Use everywhere.

Start with the interface you already use. MCP, REST, Node, Python, n8n, and the dashboard all meet the same scoped memory backend.

MCPRESTNodePythonn8nDashboard
quickstart
npm install itsuki

import { MemoryClient } from "itsuki";

const memory = new MemoryClient({
  apiKey: process.env.ITSUKI_API_KEY,
});

await memory.add("The pricing review moved to October.");
const { context } = await memory.search("When is the review?");
